newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SILENZI SET TO RETURN TO ITALY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SILENZI SET TO RETURN TO ITALY.

text.p: Andreas Silenzi's unsuccessful Nottingham Forest career is likely to come to an end within the next 48 hours.
Silenzi is set to return to Italy to join Serie B side Venezia on loan until the end of the season with a view to a permanent move.
Forest have had talks with Venezia and the loan deal is likely to be struck this weekend.
The Italian international has struggled to make his mark at Forest following his 1.8 million pounds ($2.84 million) arrival from Torino at the start of last season.
Dogged by injury and illness, he made just 20 cup and league appearances for Forest, scoring twice.
